title: On Wasserstein Two Sample Testing and Related Families of Nonparametric Tests

sections: Appendix A proof of the one-dimensional quantile representation
verified_claims: Wasserstein distance is a nonparametric two-sample distribution-comparison object
one-dimensional Wasserstein distance has a quantile-function representation
equal-size uniform empirical samples reduce to monotone sorted matching
Wasserstein, energy, and Cramer-von Mises are related but distinct constructions

claim_boundary: The paper supplies the statistical object and relationships only. It does not test WTI, this exact permutation boundary, continuation direction, or any trading result.
